create_BisimAgent: create a BisimAgent instance with observation shape, action shape, device, and transition model type
select_action_BisimAgent: select a greedy action from the actor policy given an observation tensor
sample_action_BisimAgent: sample a stochastic action from the actor policy given an observation tensor
update_BisimAgent: run one training step updating critic, encoder, transition model, and actor from replay buffer
save_load_BisimAgent: save or load BisimAgent model checkpoints for actor, critic, and reward decoder
